meta.title: Tracefab — Operations
meta.description: Tracefab Operations — outbox health, scheduler and operational dependencies.

operations.authBody: This view is reserved for owners and admins of Tracefab organisations.
operations.title: Processing health, made visible.
operations.lede: Track durable notifications, the outbox queue, the scheduler and alerting dependencies without exposing business data or PII.

rules.title: Operating rules
rules.body: Metrics are aggregated per organisation and contain no emails, no request titles and no raw supplier errors.
rules.outbox: The outbox remains the durable source of truth. An unavailable external alert does not block processing.
